<?php
function peerShift230() { global $late, $owner, $runner; $late = 99; $owner = null; $runner = null; echo 'SHIFT;'; return false; }
class PeerCallerBase230 {
    public $tag = 9;
    public function run($value) {
        global $owner;
        return $owner->MiSsInG(first: false, later: ($this->capture(...))($value, peerShift230()));
    }
    public static function capture($saved, $marker) {
        echo 'CAPTURE:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';';
        return $saved;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'THIS-END;'; }
}
class PeerCallerChild230 extends PeerCallerBase230 {}
class PeerMagicBase230 {
    public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) {
        global $kept; $kept = $arguments['later']; echo 'MAGIC;'; return false;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; }
}
class PeerMagicChild230 extends PeerMagicBase230 {}
$runner = new PeerCallerChild230;
$owner = new PeerMagicChild230;
$prefix = 'REQUEST-'; $late = $prefix . 'OLD'; $kept = null;
$result = $runner->run($late);
echo 'RETURN;'; echo 'VALUE:', $kept, ';'; unset($kept); unset($late); echo 'AFTER;';
